benchmark.name: Broad US Credit-Market Distress Benchmark
benchmark.description: Weekly semantic-measurement benchmark spanning public spreads, traded credit, systemic credit conditions, bank lending standards, and loan performance.

estimand.target_name: current broad US credit-market distress state
estimand.scope: system-wide US corporate and bank-intermediated credit conditions; not issuer default probability, expected loss, or a trading forecast

states.definition: Credit availability, pricing, liquidity, and traded-credit behavior are broadly benign.
Credit conditions show a meaningful but not broadly stressed deterioration.
Deterioration is broad or pronounced across several credit channels.
Credit conditions are exceptionally impaired relative to the walk-forward historical record.

reference_construction.warning: The reference distribution is induced by a prespecified index and is not claimed to be the market's latent true posterior.
reference_construction.categorical_reference: argmax of the constructed soft reference distribution
reference_construction.slow_context_policy: SLOOS and delinquency observations are shifted by a conservative 45 days and excluded from the reference score.

temporal_holdout.purpose: separate recent-era distribution-shift audit; not used to fit the primary calibrator

provenance.freeze_gate: Obtain archival-vintage verification, independent label-rule review, and license review before freezing or claiming deployment-valid point-in-time performance.
